summary: Autolus Therapeutics plc filed an 8-K on August 3, 2026, reporting entry into a senior secured notes facility with Perceptive Credit Holdings V, LP as administrative agent. The facility provides up to $250.0 million, with an initial tranche of $75.0 million issued on July 30, 2026, and up to $175.0 million in three additional tranches subject to revenue milestones. The notes mature July 30, 2031, with monthly interest. The filing is a material definitive agreement and direct financial obligation, not a special situation, as it is a routine financing arrangement.
